segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I had us down for 42 seats to start, with the implementation package and a June 17 go-live. Is that still the right shape?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add three more seats in support later, but for the initial order it's 42. Finance wants the invoice split annual subscription and services as separate line items.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. The subscription would be $31,920 for the year, and implementation is $6,400 one time. Both can be on the same invoice with separate lines, or two invoices if they prefer.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Same invoice is fine. Payment terms are net 30, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, net 30. The order form will show a 12-month term starting June 17, with renewal on June 17 next year. No auto-increase language beyond the standard renewal notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal already reviewed the master terms last quarter for our pilot, so I don't expect much there. Can you include the pilot credit?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, the $2,000 pilot credit is applied to the first-year subscription, so the net subscription line is $29,920. Services stays at $6,400.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For go-live, we need admin training the week of June 3 and end-user training the following week. Is that still available?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. I checked with the services team this morning. They have June 4 for admin training and June 11 for end users, both at 1 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If we get it today, I can route it for signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it over this afternoon with the seat count, invoice line items, pilot credit, and the two training dates listed in the notes.
